narrative.overview: AirClean is the soi's registered motorcycle-taxi stand (วินมอเตอร์ไซค์) translated into AirClean blue. Every job and every technician wears a numbered vest-blue plate whose key number (a price, a payout, a distance) reads at arm's length, and a reflective orange strip marks whose turn it is. Vest-blue fields carry the shell (rail, band) and the plates; plain white working cards sit on a cool ground with navy ink. The app refuses the delivery-app default where every object is the same grey card with a small blue button. Controls are standard ones people already know; the world shows in colour, type, density and the plate.
keyCharacteristics: Vest-blue gradient fields for the frame and for the one fact that matters.
White cards on a cool blue-grey ground; navy, never black, ink.
Orange appears only when it is this person's turn now.
Kanit numerals and headings, read like a vest's printed number.
Large touch targets (48px, 52px large) for outdoor, one-handed use.

rules.name: The Your-Turn-Only Rule
rules.body: `--v-turn` marks exactly one thing: what this person must do now. Never use it for emphasis, promotion or brand.

rules.name: The Token Source Rule
rules.body: Colours come from `--v-*`. Raw hex belongs in `tokens.css` only, except brand-mandated third-party buttons.

rules.name: The Numerals-in-Kanit Rule
rules.body: Any number or date in data uses `ui-num` (Kanit, tabular-nums) so columns align and figures read as plates.

rules.name: The Blue Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with ink or vest-blue-900, never neutral grey, and only lift what sits above the ground.

rules.name: The Single Sheen Rule
rules.body: When a strip appears it makes one sheen sweep (`ui-glint`, 1.1s, once, 0.25s delay), and none under reduced motion. Nothing else in the app animates for attention.

dos: Do take every colour, size, gap, radius, shadow and duration from `--v-*` tokens.
Do put an object's key number on a `Plate`; make the first-in-line plate blue and the rest `quiet`.
Do use `ui-btn is-primary` for the one main action and `is-lg` (52px) for the pinned phone action.
Do show a problem next to its field with `Problem` and focus it.
Do put new area styles in that area's stylesheet under its own prefix, refining `ui-*` rather than re-creating it.
Do use `ui-num` for numbers and dates in data.
donts: Don't use `--v-turn` orange for anything except the person's turn now.
Don't write raw hex outside `tokens.css`, except brand-mandated third-party buttons.
Don't animate anything for attention other than the strip's single sheen.
Don't add new global stylesheets; the globals are `index.css`, `tokens.css`, `ui.css`, `shell.css`.
Don't style with Tailwind beyond small layout glue (`flex`, `gap-2`, `flex-wrap`): preflight is off and the world lives in `ui-*`.
Don't put plates in admin tables; admin plates stay on queue counts and the rail.
